Compose a referent's monthly report

report_message.Rd

Two forms, told apart by the first word of the subject, which is what shows in a list of mail without opening anything: Tutto in ordine: ... when there is nobody to look at, Da guardare (N): ... otherwise, with N in brackets so that the subject does not carry two colons in a row. The mail is plain text, so the verdict is said again on the first line of the body, in capitals (TUTTO IN ORDINE, DA GUARDARE: N; ALL CLEAR, TO REVIEW: N): a number right before a numbered list would read as the number of its first item. N counts the people listed in full in the items to look at, a person once even when they are on two servers or in both items (the user name compared without case), and not the accesses activated or the expirations, which are information.

Usage

report_message(report, period)

Arguments

report

One referent's report, as report_assemble() builds it.

period

What report_month() answered.

Value

A list with subject, body, forma (in_ordine or da_guardare) and n.

Details

The items come in the order of the draft: 1. no first sign-in on the server, 2. no access in more than a year, 3. the expirations of the month (only if there are any), then the accesses activated. In the all-clear form items 1 and 2 say "none" with their number. The people of the referent that went to IT without being judged are counted in a line of their own, which changes neither the verdict nor the number in the subject: those say what was measured.

Italian above and English below, as every mail of the channel, since the address says nothing about which one its reader reads.
